videos.caption: The Silent Echo, 2021 Suman Sen (writer director) @sumansen In Mustang - one of the remotest districts of Nepal - childhood is often threatened by “loss, migration, and vanishing certainties.” Here, geography dictates destiny. When confronted by this harsh landscape, what do children dream of? What brings them joy, and how far do they travel for it? ‘The Silent Echo’ is director Suman Sen’s attempt to “listen to children growing up in a landscape where nature is both guardian and threat.” The film follows the journey of four young friends from Mustang who are determined to navigate the practical obstacles to achieve one big dream - winning a band competition in a distant town. Despite the bleak conditions, the children share inner worlds which remain tender and playful. #nepal #girlhood

Fresh floods and landslides set off by heavy rain and storms have killed at least 14 people in Nepal and left another 11 missing, with authorities warning on Sunday that more flash floods were possible. The warnings covered 49 of Nepal's 77 districts, more than half of which faced a high risk of flooding, as water levels in major rivers kept rising. The video filmed at 5:30pm, local time, on Sunday, September 27 shows the latest destruction. It comes after a glacier collapsed near the border with China's Tibet Autonomous Region in late August, sending landslides and a flash flood through valleys downstream and killing more than 1,450 people. #ABCNews #Nepal #Landslide #Floods

The emotional scene reflects the devastating impact of the floods on ordinary families across Nepal.
